agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MAY 20, 2020 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
Pursuant to the State of California Executive Orders and the amended County Health Orders, members of the public will only be allowed to participate in meetings electronically.
Meeting can be accessed as follows:
• Channel 19 on Cox Communications
• Channel 24 on Time Warner Cable
• Channel 99 on AT&T U-Verse
• City's live webcast: https://encinitasca.gov/Government/Agendas-Webcasts
Public Comments (including oral communications and agenda item related)
Public comments regarding this agenda must be submitted via email to clerk@encinitasca.gov
Comments received by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the Board and read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Board President.
Comments received after 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the Board and made a part of the meeting record.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS - NONE
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the April 15, 2020 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-05-20 SDWD Item S08A Minutes

Informational Report Regarding San Dieguito Water District’s Water Rates and Meter Service Charges Effective June 1, 2020. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu

2020-05-20 SDWD Item S08C 2nd Year Rate Adjustment
8D.
Authorization to enter into a Professional Services Contract with Infrastructure Engineering Corporation to prepare the Water Master Plan 2020 Update (2020 Update) and the Water Capacity Fee Study. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Knoll
1) Authorize the City Manager to execute a contract with Infrastructure Engineering Corporation (IEC) in substantial form as included in Attachment 1, in consultation with the City Attorney, in the amount of $230,448 plus a 10 percent staff-authorized contingency for a total not to exceed amount of $253,493; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-07, to amend the FY 2019-20 budget by transferring $103,495 from Project No. CW20C, Water Infrastructure Improvements fund to Project No. CW20I, Water Master Plan Update.
2020-05-20 SDWD Item S08D Water Master Plan Consultant - IEC

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
